title: Unknown command
message: Unknown command {command_id}.
basic_text: Rastai doesn't have this command.
fix_text: Check the command's spelling.

title: Invalid command arguments
message: Invalid arguments: got {found}; expected {expected}.
basic_text: This request is missing something or has a wrong value.
fix_text: Fix the argument shown and try again.

title: Command belongs to a disabled or missing plugin
message: {command_id} belongs to the plugin {plugin_id}, which is disabled or missing.
basic_text: This command comes from a plugin that is off or not installed.
fix_text: Install or turn on the plugin.

title: Idempotency key reused with different arguments
message: The idempotency key {idempotency_key} was already used with different arguments.
basic_text: This request reuses the id of a different request.
fix_text: Send a new idempotency key with a different request.

title: Command interrupted by a daemon restart
message: {command_id} was interrupted by a daemon restart.
basic_text: Rastai restarted while this was running, so it didn't finish.
fix_text: Run it again.

title: The daemon is running a different app version
message: The daemon is running version {daemon_version}, but this app is version {app_version}.
basic_text: The background service is a different version from this app.
fix_text: Restart the daemon.

title: Command retired; use its replacement
message: {command_id} is retired; use {replacement_command_id} instead.
basic_text: This command was replaced by a newer one.
fix_text: Use the replacement shown.

title: Update in progress
message: An update is in progress; try again in a moment.
basic_text: Rastai is updating itself right now.
fix_text: Wait for the update to finish, then try again.

title: A settings file doesn't parse
message: The settings file {path} doesn't parse, so it was left as it is: {reason}.
basic_text: One of your settings files has a mistake. Rastai never overwrites it.
fix_text: Fix the file first, then try again.

title: Command not available yet
message: {command_id} isn't available in this version of Rastai yet.
basic_text: This feature is planned but not built yet in this version of Rastai.
fix_text: Nothing to fix on your side: the feature arrives in a later version.

title: Events missed outside the daemon's bus buffer
message: Events after sequence {sequence} are no longer in the daemon's bus buffer; the client refetches state.
basic_text: The app fell behind on updates and is reloading the current state.

title: No home folder for the data folders
message: There is no home folder to put Rastai's data folders in.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't find your home folder, so it has nowhere to keep its data.
fix_text: Set RASTAI_HOME to a folder, or HOME on Linux and macOS and USERPROFILE on Windows.

title: The operating system's random source can't be read
message: The operating system's random source can't be read: {reason}.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't get the random numbers it needs from your system.
fix_text: Restart the computer; if it keeps happening, report the problem.

title: No free port in 47820–47829
message: No free port in 47820–47829.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't find a free network port to start on.
fix_text: Close the programs using these ports, or set daemon.port to a free one.

title: Not signed in, or unknown credential
message: Not signed in, or the credential is unknown.
basic_text: You're not signed in.
fix_text: Sign in again.

title: Host header not allowed
message: The Host header {host} is not allowed.
basic_text: This request came through an address Rastai doesn't accept.
fix_text: Open Rastai through the address it printed when it started.

title: Origin not allowed
message: The Origin {origin} is not allowed.
basic_text: This request came from a web page Rastai doesn't trust.
fix_text: Open Rastai through the address it printed when it started.

title: Scope not granted
message: {command_id} needs the scope {scope}, which {principal} wasn't granted.
basic_text: You don't have permission to do this.
fix_text: Use a token that has the scope shown.

title: Token revoked
message: This token was revoked.
basic_text: This access key no longer works.
fix_text: Create a new token.

title: Login code expired or already used
message: The login code expired or was already used.
basic_text: This sign-in link no longer works.
fix_text: Open Rastai again to get a new link.

title: Owner token's mode isn't 0600; the daemon refuses to start
message: The owner token {path} has a mode other than 0600, so the daemon refuses to start.
basic_text: Rastai's key file doesn't have the permissions it needs to stay private, so Rastai won't start.
fix_text: Run chmod 600 {path}, then start Rastai again.

title: The project's data policy forbids this
message: The project's data policy ({data_policy}) forbids this.
basic_text: This project's privacy setting doesn't allow sending this data off this computer.
fix_text: Change privacy.data_policy for the project, or for your user outside a project, if you want to allow it.

title: The owner token can't be read or created; the daemon refuses to start
message: The owner token {path} can't be read or created, so the daemon refuses to start: {reason}.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't open or write its key file, so it won't start.
fix_text: Check that you own {path} and its folder and can read and write them. If the file is damaged, delete it; the next start writes a new one.

title: Nothing to undo or redo
message: Nothing to undo or redo.
basic_text: There is nothing to undo or redo.

title: Document changed outside Rastai; undo history cleared
message: {path} changed outside Rastai, so its undo history was cleared.
basic_text: This file was changed by another program, so its undo history was reset.

title: Malformed MCP request
message: Malformed MCP request: {reason}.
basic_text: An assistant tool sent Rastai a request it couldn't understand.
fix_text: Check the MCP client's version and settings.

title: MCP bridge has no token
message: The MCP bridge has no token.
basic_text: The assistant connection isn't set up with an access key.
fix_text: Create a token and set it in the MCP bridge's settings.
